examples.title: Sunset over the sea
examples.description: Mixes its own orange with COLOR= and paints a setting sun and its reflection in SCREEN 5, the MSX2's 16-colour bitmap mode; press any key to return to BASIC.

examples.title: Times table
examples.description: Asks which times table you would like and prints it from 1 to 10, lined up in columns with PRINT USING.

examples.title: Catch the star
examples.description: Move the basket with the cursor keys to catch the falling stars; after three misses, press Space to play again.

manuals.title: Philips NMS 8250 Computer - Gebruiksaanwijzing
manuals.note: Owner's manual for this machine (1986), in Dutch; Internet Archive scan

manuals.title: A Guide to MSX-BASIC Version 2.0
manuals.note: MSX2 BASIC guide and reference chart (Sony, 1985); the same BASIC family as this machine's; Internet Archive scan

manuals.title: Kaikkien MSX
manuals.note: Finnish introduction to MSX and MSX-BASIC (Amersoft, 1985), PDF scan, about 60 MB
